title: Excellent sequence number wraparound handling with half-window semantics
description:
File: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs
Lines: 582-622

The `seq_is_fresher` function correctly implements RFC 6621 half-window semantics using `wrapping_sub`. The test suite (lines 898-978) provides comprehensive coverage of:
- Equal values
- Simple increment/decrement
- Half-range boundaries (0x7FFF, 0x8000)
- Wraparound at 0xFFFF -> 0x0000
- Near-boundary cases

This is non-trivial to get right and the implementation is correct.
